raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Fixes #43158.

`get_rope_config` treats Transformers v5 per-layer RoPE dictionaries as flat parameters. For example, `Gemma3TextConfig` returns a theta of 10,000 instead of the full-attention value of 1,000,000. DeepSeek-V4 compressed layers also receive the outer dictionary, so reading `original_max_position_embeddings` raises `KeyError`.

## Modifications

- Select the requested layer's RoPE parameters, defaulting to `full_attention` or `main` for nested configurations.
- Select `compress` parameters for DeepSeek-V4 compressed layers, preserving their theta and YaRN settings. Flat and legacy configurations retain the existing `compress_rope_theta` behavior.
- Add real Transformers config coverage and compare the RoPE frequency tables initialized by pure SWA, C4 and C128 layers.

## Accuracy Tests

On unmodified upstream, the new config tests fail and the layer regression produces an incorrect SWA frequency table and `KeyError` for C4/C128. With the fix, all relevant tests pass:

```text
python -m pytest test/registered/unit/utils/test_hf_transformers.py test/registered/unit/utils/test_hf_transformers_loading.py test/registered/unit/models/test_deepseek_v4_rope_policy.py -q
89 passed, 28 subtests passed
```

CPU validation with Python 3.12.13, PyTorch 2.14.1 and Transformers 5.19.0. The layer tests use the existing stubs for attention and linear modules; they exercise real RoPE frequency construction. No model-weight or GPU inference test was run.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not run. This changes configuration selection during initialization, with no changes to the forward path or kernels.

## Checklist

- [x] Format the changed files with pre-commit; all applicable hooks pass.
- [x] Add regression tests in the existing registered CPU suites.
- [ ] Update documentation (no serving API or CLI changes).
- [ ] Provide model accuracy and speed benchmarks (CPU configuration and RoPE tests only).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style guidance.

+def get_rope_config(config, layer_type: Optional[str] = None):
     """Get (rope_theta, rope_params) from config, supporting both v4 and v5.
 
     Trust-remote-code configs or parent configs passed to sub-models may not
     have the v5 ``rope_parameters`` property, so we fall back to the v4-style
     ``config.rope_theta`` / ``config.rope_scaling`` attributes.
 
+    For per-layer-type v5 configs, select ``layer_type``. When omitted,
+    select ``full_attention`` or ``main``. Flat configs ignore this argument.
+
     Returns:
-        (rope_theta, rope_params): In v5, rope_params is the full
+        (rope_theta, rope_params): In v5, rope_params is the selected
         rope_parameters dict (which subsumes rope_scaling and includes
         rope_theta). In v4, rope_params is the rope_scaling dict or None.
     """
     rope_params = getattr(config, "rope_parameters", None)
     if rope_params is not None:
+        if rope_params and all(isinstance(v, dict) for v in rope_params.values()):
+            if layer_type is None:
+                layer_type = (
+                    "full_attention" if "full_attention" in rope_params else "main"
+                )
+            rope_params = rope_params[layer_type]
         rope_theta = rope_params.get("rope_theta", getattr(config, "rope_theta", 10000))
         return rope_theta, rope_params
     return getattr(config, "rope_theta", 10000), getattr(config, "rope_scaling", None)
